title: crataegus segobricensis
intro: Crataegus segobricensis, commonly known as the Segobriga hawthorn, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family Rosaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the potential to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and possess antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus segobricensis are believed to be due to its ability to act as a vasodilator, improve lipid profiles, and exhibit anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
